name: Manitowoc County, WI
findings: Manitowoc County has 261 nonprofit organizations. 97 of them (37%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 78 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (26% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Manitowoc County has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Hobby and sports organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 13 hobby and sports organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.

confidence.text: Based on 13 organizations here; 42% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do hobby and sports organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?
